verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs confirm multi-currency payout configuration (adyen-docs-22) and local payouts that avoid SWIFT fees when you hold a matching local bank account (adyen-docs-13), plus localized checkout for shoppers (adyen-docs-19), which supports charging locally and settling internationally. However, there is no explicit documentation of automatic FX conversion rates, markup transparency, or a single-currency settlement guarantee when accepting many currencies. missing for 10: explicit FX conversion/markup disclosure, documentation of auto-consolidation to one settlement currency, and independent confirmation of FX transparency in practice.
